title: Pair decoding with linear time and space
statement: There exist a finite Turing machine $M$ over the Boolean alphabet and a constant $c\in\mathbb{N}$ such that, on every Boolean string $x$, $M$ halts with output equal to the second component returned by the pair parser when parsing succeeds, and the empty string when parsing fails, within $c(|x|+1)$ steps. For every $x$ and every $t\in\mathbb{N}$, the total work space used by $M$ through step $t$ is at most $c(|x|+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite Turing machine and constant exist
space bound c(|x|+1) for every input and every t
